neighbours.label: (sub-trigger of a broad pole) ' of' after a word for a kind or form: 'a particular kind of', 'in the form of'
fire: Which group became linked with a certain kind of music?
Help comes in the form of small loans.
She prefers a particular type of cheese.
It was a strange sort of silence.
Rain falls in the form of snow up there.
He wrote a new kind of poem.
Each student chose some type of sport.
The reward came in the form of a letter.
quiet: Which group became linked with a certain town in Spain?
Help comes in small loans from the bank.
She prefers a cup of tea and cheese.
It was a strange piece of luck.
Rain falls on the roof of the barn up there.
He wrote the end of the poem.
Each student chose a bag of apples.
The reward came at the end of the year.

notes: The card flags this pole broad; ' of' 10, '的' 3. Probes: ' of' after 'kind' 0.68, 'form' 0.54, 的 0.38, ' own' 0.36. The near misses keep ' of' after concrete nouns, so the question is whether this ' of' is special.
